title: nan
authors: Chen Q.; Irfan M.; Yu Q.; Sun J.; Din M.U.; Lin D.; Dong Y.; He S.; Hussain I.
key_contribution: Presents an autonomous heterogeneous multirobot system (UAVs and USV) for object retrieval in GNSS-denied maritime environments using UWB beacons for UAV localization, validated in field trials.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
